from build123d import *
import math

# Parameters
outer_diameter = 120
bore_diameter = 40
bolt_hole_diameter = 11
pcd = 95  # bolt circle diameter
num_bolts = 6
thickness = 14

# Build the flange
with BuildPart() as flange:
    # Main disc
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        Circle(radius=outer_diameter / 2)
        Circle(radius=bore_diameter / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=thickness)
    
    # Six bolt holes equally spaced on PCD
    with BuildSketch() as bolt_sk:
        with Locations(*(
            (
                (pcd / 2) * math.cos(math.radians(i * 360 / num_bolts)),
                (pcd / 2) * math.sin(math.radians(i * 360 / num_bolts))
            )
            for i in range(num_bolts)
        )):
            Circle(radius=bolt_hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=-thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

result = flange.part

import math

# Parameters
outer_diameter = 120
bore_diameter = 40
bolt_hole_diameter = 11
bolt_circle_diameter = 95
thickness = 14
num_bolts = 6

# Create the flange plate
with BuildPart() as flange:
    # Main cylinder
    Cylinder(radius=outer_diameter / 2, height=thickness)
    
    # Central bore (subtract)
    Cylinder(radius=bore_diameter / 2, height=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    
    # Bolt holes equally spaced on bolt circle
    bolt_circle_radius = bolt_circle_diameter / 2
    for i in range(num_bolts):
        angle = math.radians(i * 360 / num_bolts)
        x = bolt_circle_radius * math.cos(angle)
        y = bolt_circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
        with Locations((x, y, 0)):
            Cylinder(radius=bolt_hole_diameter / 2, height=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

result = flange.part

from build123d import *
import math

# Parameters
outer_diameter = 120  # mm
bore_diameter = 40    # mm
bolt_hole_diameter = 11  # mm
bolt_circle_diameter = 95  # mm (PCD)
num_bolts = 6
thickness = 14  # mm

# Create the flange plate
with BuildPart() as flange:
    # Main cylinder (flange body)
    Cylinder(radius=outer_diameter / 2, height=thickness)
    
    # Central bore (subtract)
    Cylinder(radius=bore_diameter / 2, height=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    
    # Bolt holes equally spaced on PCD
    bolt_radius = bolt_circle_diameter / 2
    with PolarLocations(radius=bolt_radius, count=num_bolts):
        Cylinder(radius=bolt_hole_diameter / 2, height=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

result = flange.part

with BuildPart() as shaft:

    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(radius=20, height=80, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    
    # Left bearing seat: diameter 30 mm, 20 mm long
    # Positioned so its right face touches the left face of central section
    # Center at z = -40 - 10 = -50
    with Locations((0, 0, -50)):
        Cylinder(radius=15, height=20, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    
    # Right bearing seat: diameter 30 mm, 20 mm long
    # Center at z = 40 + 10 = 50
    with Locations((0, 0, 50)):
        Cylinder(radius=15, height=20, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))

result = shaft.part

# Stepped shaft: total length 120 mm along Z axis
# Central section: D40, L80
# Two end bearing seats: D30, L20 each
# Total: 20 + 80 + 20 = 120 mm

with BuildPart() as shaft:
    # Central section
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(radius=20, height=80, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    
    # Left bearing seat (at -Z end)
    with Locations((0, 0, -50)):  # center at -40 - 10 = -50
        Cylinder(radius=15, height=20, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    
    # Right bearing seat (at +Z end)
    with Locations((0, 0, 50)):  # center at +40 + 10 = +50
        Cylinder(radius=15, height=20, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))

result = shaft.part
